trap.see: The free key on top of the clock is the one to leave alone: dig out the far key first, then take both keys together, or the early key sits in the tray until the tray is full.
fairWhy: the only winning moves are not goal-directed (obvious.js) under some deal

examples.text: Try 20 of campaign 4: the first losing move (off stored clock route, tile 80) was removal 1 of 84, at a designed trap; the loss (tray) showed 5 removals later.
